headword: {人工衛星|じんこうえいせい}

definitions.explanation: A man-made object placed in orbit around the Earth or another celestial body, used for communication, observation, navigation, and scientific research.

examples.japanese: {人工衛星|じんこうえいせい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{打|う}ち{上|あ}げた→打ち上げる：06732_uchiageru⟧。
GPS⟦{信号|しんごう}→信号：03258_shingou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{人工衛星|じんこうえいせい}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{送|おく}られている→送る：00742_okuru⟧。
examples.english: GPS signals are transmitted from artificial satellites.

examples.japanese: ⟦{地球|ちきゅう}→地球：03461_chikyuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{周|まわ}り→周り：01732_mawari⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{数千|すうせん}⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{人工衛星|じんこうえいせい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{軌道|きどう}→軌道：06360_kidou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{回|まわ}っている→回る：01150_mawaru⟧。
examples.english: Thousands of artificial satellites are orbiting around the Earth.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{人工|じんこう}→人工：11573_jinkou⟧ (artificial) + ⟦{衛星|えいせい}→衛星：01880_eisei⟧ (satellite). Often shortened to ⟦{衛星|えいせい}→衛星：01880_eisei⟧ when the context is clear.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {人工衛星|じんこうえいせい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{打|う}ち{上|あ}げる→打ち上げる：06732_uchiageru⟧ (to launch a satellite)
- ⟦{気象|きしょう}→気象：09943_kishou⟧⟦{衛星|えいせい}→衛星：01880_eisei⟧ (weather satellite)
- ⟦{通信|つうしん}→通信：03514_tsuushin⟧⟦{衛星|えいせい}→衛星：01880_eisei⟧ (communications satellite)
- {偵察|ていさつ}⟦{衛星|えいせい}→衛星：01880_eisei⟧ (reconnaissance satellite)
- ⟦{衛星|えいせい}→衛星：01880_eisei⟧⟦{軌道|きどう}→軌道：06360_kidou⟧ (satellite orbit)

USAGE:
In everyday conversation, ⟦{衛星|えいせい}→衛星：01880_eisei⟧ alone is often sufficient when referring to artificial satellites. The full form {人工衛星|じんこうえいせい} is used to distinguish from ⟦{天然|てんねん}→天然：03560_tennen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{衛星|えいせい}→衛星：01880_eisei⟧ (natural satellites, such as the Moon).
